relationships.subject: TRPM3
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that TRPM3 is essential for ongoing pain and allodynia following trigeminal nerve injury

relationships.subject: primidone
relationships.evidence_quote: Primidone itself is not active at GABAA receptors but directly inhibits TRPM3 at submicromolar concentrations (IC50 = 600 nM)

relationships.subject: primidone
relationships.evidence_quote: isosakuranetin, primidone, and carbamazepine significantly attenuated the mechanical allodynia that develops during the late phase of the IoN-CCI model

key_findings: Trpm3-/- mice do not develop spontaneous pain or mechanical allodynia after infraorbital nerve CCI, despite similar trigeminal ganglion transcriptome changes.
TRPM3 antagonists primidone and isosakuranetin reverse allodynia and spontaneous pain, whereas the TRPV1 antagonist mavatrep does not.
